Name: Axolotl Village
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
Currently adds: a new island, 13 NPCs, 9 fish, 60+ events, 75+ foods/recipes, 40+ furniture, 3 holidays, new crops/trees, new quests/mail and more!
I will also continue adding updates that add more of all of these things~

[color=#ff0000][size=3]The story in this mod directly follows the story in the Kin the Axolotl mod. If you haven't seen all of the events in that mod, then some things might be confusing but otherwise it's not a requirement. Certain events and dialogue in this mod will also spoil things in the Kin the Axolotl mod.[/size][/color]

[b][size=5][u]How to Access the Village:
[/u][/size][/b][spoiler]The wizard will send you a letter asking you to visit his tower ([b]requirement for letter[/b]: have at least 2 hearts with the Wizard). After visiting him, he'll give you two options for warping to the village: A village warp totem you can craft yourself, or a warp point on the left pier at the beach.[/spoiler]
